items.heading: Pendula View
items.text: Slumber amidst sophisticated gardens and enjoy the city’s namesake willows

items.heading: Ferryboat
items.text: Take in the sights of the old ferryboat along the Willow Creek Canal. She lights up the night!

items.heading: Home to Bob Pancakes
items.text: Stroll around Courtyard Lane for a chance to see the legendary Bob Pancakes!

items.heading: Brontosaurus Bend
items.text: Visit your home away from home in the desert suburbs of Brontosaurus Bend

items.heading: Abandoned Mine
items.text: The old forgotten mine near Acquisition Butte is a must-see for any explorer

items.heading: Mirage Canyon Lookout
items.text: Visit Oasis Spring's namesake body of water while passing through Mirage Canyon

items.heading: Lots of Space!
items.text: Looking for vast open space to ponder your next building project? Look no further

items.heading: Peace and Quiet
items.text: Not everyone wants an adrenaline rush on their vacation. Find peaceful refuge here

items.heading: Plenty Room to Jog
items.text: Newcrest is the perfect location to get in those steps that you’ve been promising yourself

items.heading: Scout Out Your Shop Location
items.text: Looking for the perfect spot to finally open your own retail business? Search no more!

items.heading: Outdoor Park Activities
items.text: Keep the kids entertained with a small playground and a small outdoor eating area

items.heading: Watch the Ducks
items.text: Enjoy a quiet outdoor seating area by the river where the ducks like to play

items.heading: The Bluffs
items.text: Visit this steamy, secluded natural pool overlooking the crystalline Lake Windenburg

items.heading: Von Haunt Estate
items.text: The original owners of this preserved estate loved it so much, they’re still here!

items.heading: Olde Platz Ruins
items.text: Take a leisurely stroll around the old ruins that used to circle Windenburg Castle

items.heading: Festivals
items.text: Festivals are happening daily in San Myshuno, so you’ll never be short on fun things to do!

items.heading: Night Life
items.text: Who needs sleep? Experience the city at night and all the unique folks you may meet

items.heading: Myshuno Meadows
items.text: Enjoy some lovely views of the city while jogging or playing ball in this Center Park

items.heading: The Best Dog Walking Paths
items.text: For a trip that will truly impress your pup, nothing beats Cavalier Cove’s sandy dog walking paths

items.heading: Lighthouse
items.text: Deadgrass Isle has the most creative spot for couples looking to spice up their love life

items.heading: Whiskerman's Wharf
items.text: Come for the sea breeze, chowder, and lobster rolls. Stay for the cuddly local kitties

items.heading: Starlight Boulevard
items.text: Stroll the Boulevard and spot tiles of stars like Brytani Cho and Dirk Dreamer

items.heading: Picturesque Views
items.text: Assuming the day is nice and clear, The Pinnacles offers a fantastic view of Del Sol Valley

items.heading: Celebrities!
items.text: Del Sol Valley is the prime location for a chance at meeting a Proper Celebrity!

items.heading: Active Volcano!
items.text: Get up close and personal with Sulani’s active volcano! Or admire it safely from afar...

items.heading: Ocean Activities
items.text: Sulani’s crisp ocean waters are your aquatic haven for Swimming, Snorkeling, or making a dolphin friend!

items.heading: Local Culture
items.text: Meet new friends and learn about local culture at various local events in Ohan’ali Town

items.heading: University of Britechester Campus
items.text: Come tour the historic University of Britechester where a budding artist can flourish!

items.heading: Foxbury Institute Campus
items.text: Come visit the innovative campus of Foxbury to see if a future in technology is right for you

items.heading: Historic Mysteries
items.text: From campus ghosts to an elusive Secret Society, Britechester boasts its share of the unexplained

items.heading: Port Promise
items.text: This smoggy old port may make you gag, but it’s an adequate place to learn about industrialization

items.heading: Grims Quarry
items.text: The quaint suburbs near the historic quarry is a sweet destination for any evergreen enthusiast

items.heading: Conifer Station
items.text: This pretty area on the outskirts of the city has a historic train station to visit

items.heading: Snow Sports
items.text: The mountain town of Yukimatsu is a snowy escape for skiing, snowboarding, sledding, and rock climbing

items.heading: Onsen Venue
items.text: After a fun (or painful?) day of frolicking in the snow, relax and recover in the Onsen’s healing hot springs

items.heading: Mountain Climbing Excursion
items.text: Plan a group Excursion and attempt to reach the summit of Mt. Komorebi

items.heading: Ramble the Bramblewood
items.text: Gather mushrooms, befriend wild rabbits and birds, enjoy the ruins, and stop by Sophie the Snail in these lush woods

items.heading: A Cozy Village
items.text: The small but lively village of Finchwick is home to friendly locals and shop stalls

items.heading: Weekly Fair
items.text: Enter the weekly fair for a chance to prove that your animal, produce, or cooking is the cream of the crop

items.heading: Pier Attractions
items.text: Bring friends, family, or even a special someone, to enjoy the thrills of Plumbite Pier's waterfront fairground filled with attractions.

items.heading: Academia
items.text: Learning is always an adventure! Dive into academics or take a break from studying to cheer on the Womp Womps at a Copperdale High afterschool festival.

items.heading: Town Centre
items.text: Home to residents and bustling with teens, come enjoy the tea, trends, and tales of Prescott Square, Copperdale's historic central hub.

items.heading: Park Paradise
items.text: Stomp around at Whalebert's splash pad play area, fish and swim in a pond, or go for a walk on any one of our Gilbert Gardens' three walking paths surrounding Celebration Lake.

items.heading: Wharf Wonders
items.text: The heart of San Sequoia can be found at Anchorpoint Wharf, where the area's fishing industry history is still visible in the architecture.

items.heading: Family Friendly
items.text: Bring the whole family along to enjoy a movie at the wharf or a bit of a nosh at the Around the World in 80 Bites food cart.  There's plenty for all ages to see and explore!

items.heading: Explore Dreadhorse Caverns
items.text: Located in the southwestern corner of Galloping Gulch quietly nestled beneath some trees, Dreadhorse Caverns is a vast cave full of bats, bears, and giant spiders! Dance battle your way down further and further into the abyss! Solve riddles, collecting rare reward items, and find the underground land of the unicorns! How deep can you go?

items.heading: Go Horseback Riding
items.text: The trails in Galloping Gulch offer incredible views and sweeping vistas. Take your horse out and enjoy the sights and sounds, find places to camp and light a fire, or spend the night hunting for the mysterious ghost horse that haunts the park.

items.heading: Rare Fishing Spots
items.text: Find incredible fishing spots with some of the rarest fish you'll ever catch in your life! There's no better place to cast out a line and let yourself relax and unwind from the hustle and bustle of daily life.

items.heading: Night Market
items.text: Visit the famous Tomarang Night Market for some after-dark shopping and mouth-watering cuisine!

items.heading: Local Living
items.text: Embrace community and take a minute to get to know the local neighbors. Poke for local gossip, join in a game of marbles, and enjoy the warmth of this tight knit locale.

items.heading: Rich History
items.text: Dive into the lore of the land and discover hidden secrets, historical battles, and legendary tails.

items.heading: Revel in Romance
items.text: This romantic locale is perfect for singles and those looking to rekindle their love.

items.heading: Looking for Love
items.text: Still single? No worry! Find your next flame at the Nightclub, Lounge, or Gym to burn off some pent-up energy.

items.heading: Enchanting Locale
items.text: Love is in the air thanks to the romantic vistas, charming park, and passionate Sims.

items.heading: Ghosts & Grim
items.text: Want some Ghosts? Mourningvale is a literal ghost town, and Crow's Crossing village is clearly haunted! Soak in the spooky during Ravenwood's many festivals, become a temporary Ghost by taking a dip in the Baleful Bog, and possibly even run into Grim himself.

items.heading: Memorial Sites
items.text: Crypts, Cemeteries, the Afterlife Anonymous meeting, and little consoling Specters! Ravenwood is the perfect place to lift the spirits.

items.heading: Chilling Collections
items.text: Stop by the Collector Signs in any of the three neighborhoods, explore a Crypt, discover the secrets of the Tarot Tome Shrines, or check out the eerie ruins of Whispering Glen.

items.heading: Old Town Charm
items.text: Spend a romantic day in historic Gammelvik! Grab a hot drink from the market, walk the canals, and stop at a fishing spot to help keep them clean.

items.heading: Practice Your Hobby
items.text: Visit the market squares for daily hobby meetups, where you can learn a new skill while making new friends!

items.heading: Get Inked
items.text: Feeling daring? Visit a tattoo studio in Iverstad to mark your skin with a good memory.

items.heading: Bohemian Lifestyle
items.text: Embrace the bohemian lifestyle in picturesque landscapes, where all Sims can learn to live comfortably off the land.

items.heading: Healing Haven
items.text: Tap into natural healing and self-care through a strong local connection with Apothecary arts.

items.heading: An Enchanting World
items.text: From the forested Everdew to the Coast of Adhmor, delight and discovery await in the special landmarks, plants, and stories of this world.

items.heading: Natural Wonders
items.text: Wend your way towards awe-inspiring natural landmarks such as Hothead Rock Geyser, the jellyfish-filled Electric Lagoon, and Underlight Bay.

items.heading: Outdoor Activities
items.text: Looking to spend a little more time taking in some fresh air, or looking to take on some new activities in general? Try your hand at archery or kayaking, or go for a little dive off the diving board at a pool. Unique festivals will have you dipping your toes into all sorts of outdoorsy endeavors.

items.heading: Fluttery and Feathery
items.text: You'll want to fly over to Gibbi Point as fast as you can once you hear that it hosts many winged delights; from its unique butterfly and moth population to the storied Peculiar Plumbird, there's a flock-o-fun to be had here.

items.heading: Sunny Coastline
items.text: Have a day in the sun surrounded by the warm community of Dambele, nothing tastes better than one of their homemade traditional soups!

items.heading: Emerald Sea
items.text: Feeling adventurous? Get on a boat and sail around the shores of Verdemar, you might even find some buried treasures!

items.heading: Elite Lifestyle
items.text: Relax and indulge in the refined atmosphere of Bellacorde, where life feels slower but oh so luxurious.

items.heading: Camping and Cabins
items.text: Whether you’re roughing it or glamping it, Granite Falls has a variety of sites to choose from

items.heading: Insect Collecting
items.text: Power through your Squeamish sensibilities and discover some truly fascinating insects

items.heading: Granite Falls Forest
items.text: Experience the true perfection of nature by exploring the lush and beautiful Granite Falls Forest

items.heading: Great for Night Owls!
items.text: The sun rises later and sets earlier here, meaning you can enjoy more hours of darkness

items.heading: Local History
items.text: Tour relics of founders and meet residents that have “lived” here for generations

items.heading: Unique Flora
items.text: Rare plants like Plasmafruit and the Sixam Mosquito Trap can be only found here

items.heading: Explore the Jungle
items.text: It's literally a jungle out there! Don't forget to bring your spider repellent and machete!

items.heading: Hidden Temple
items.text: The more you explore, the more secret ancient rooms open up for discovery

items.heading: Ancient Artifacts
items.text: Find, purchase, and collect ancient artifacts so you can bring a piece of the jungle home with you

items.heading: Strangerville Plaza
items.text: Visit the Strangerville Information Center. This place is way more interesting than the Secret Lab

items.heading: Shady Acres Vista
items.text: Boasting the most beautiful view Strangerville has to offer, stay at Shady Acres and you too can wonder where all this wealth comes from

items.heading: Interesting Locals
items.text: You’d be hard pressed to find hospitality like this anywhere else. Just try not to let them get too close…

items.heading: Magic Portal
items.text: There are tales of a portal above the Glimmerbrook waterfall. Are you brave enough to see where it leads?

items.heading: Casters Alley
items.text: Casters Alley within the Magic Realm is your go-to shopping spot for wands, potions, and brooms

items.heading: Enchantment
items.text: Make this a truly magical vacation. Cauldrons are brewing and spells are a-casting here in Glimmerbrook

items.heading: Black Spire Outpost
items.text: This is your intergalactic hot spot for shops to purchase artifacts and try some local cuisine

items.heading: Millennium Falcon
items.text: Up your Scoundrel reputation for a chance to explore the inside of the Millenium Falcon!

items.heading: The Resistance Encampment
items.text: Take in the sights of a lush forest, waterfall, and an otherworldly cave to explore

items.heading: Village Square
items.text: Visit Porto Luminoso's various shops and market stalls. Just don't forget to try the world-famous fruit tarts!

items.heading: Romantic Sights
items.text: Romance lofts through Tartosa's air, and there's always a new adventure to be had at one of the area's various romantic sites!

items.heading: Local History
items.text: Word travels fast through Tartosa's Grapevine, and myths and legends about the area's history abound.

items.heading: Local History
items.text: This former lumber mill town may be a bit quiet, but dig a little and you're sure to surface some secrets from the past... and present!

items.heading: Natural Wonder
items.text: Surrounded by miles of wilderness and enriched by rare fauna and flora like the Luna Fish and Moonpetal Flower, Moonwood Mill is a nature-lover's paradise.

items.heading: Mysterious Sightings
items.text: The mysterious silhouettes lurking in the wilderness' trees are enough to make any visitor's fur - erm, hair - stand on end.
